constraints.name: events_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK (participant_ids @> ARRAY[actor_user_id] AND array_position(participant_ids, NULL::uuid) IS NULL)

constraints.name: events_order_id_organization_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (order_id, organization_id) REFERENCES uc_individual_orders_private.orders(id, organization_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: events_original_event_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (original_event_id) REFERENCES uc_individual_orders_private.events(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: orders_check
constraints.definition:
CHECK (family =
CASE
    WHEN order_kind = 'admission'::text THEN 'admission'::text
    ELSE 'termination'::text
END)

constraints.name: orders_check1
constraints.definition: CHECK ((approved_snapshot IS NULL) = (approved_order_revision IS NULL) AND (approved_snapshot IS NULL) = (approved_order_sha256 IS NULL) AND (approved_snapshot IS NULL) = (decision IS NULL) AND (approved_snapshot IS NULL) = (official_order_number IS NULL) AND (approved_snapshot IS NULL) = (render_job IS NULL))

constraints.name: orders_check2
constraints.definition: CHECK (approved_order_revision IS NULL OR approved_order_revision >= 1 AND approved_order_revision <= revision)

constraints.name: orders_check3
constraints.definition: CHECK (registry IS NULL OR artifact IS NOT NULL AND registered_snapshot IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: orders_check5
constraints.definition: CHECK (participant_ids @> ARRAY[subject_user_id, created_by] AND array_position(participant_ids, NULL::uuid) IS NULL)

constraints.name: orders_check6
constraints.definition: CHECK (staging_attest_request_id <> output_attest_request_id AND staging_attest_request_id <> registry_request_id AND output_attest_request_id <> registry_request_id)
